family.description: This presumed domain has no known function. It is found in one or two copies in several Caenorhabditis elegans proteins. It is roughly 130 amino acids long. The domain contains 12 conserved cysteines which suggests that the domain is an extracellular domain and that these cysteines form six intradomain disulphide bridges. The GO annotation for this protein indicates that it has a function in nematode larval development and has a positive regulation of growth rate.
family.name: Domain of unknown function (DUF19)

causal_graphs.context: BK540 is rrf-3(pk1426) II; qpIs11[unc-119; Pvha-1::gfp] I. L2 parents were exposed and F1 young adults examined on days 4-6, with general culture at 20 C. BK541 sid-1(pk3321) is the RNAi-refractory control; dpy-11, exc-1 and erm-1 are induction controls. Supplement Table S2 identifies Ahringer clone V-16K12; its exact insert sequence remains unverified.

evidence.explanation: Methods, Tables 1-2, Results and visually checked Figure 4D support a whole-gene RNAi-associated phenotype. The separately inspected Table S2 discrepancy and absence of established rescue limit specificity and quantitative interpretation.
Grounds the tested gene's reference protein in this family, without importing another family member's mechanism.

edges.mechanism: Table 2 reports 19 percent affected among 79 canals versus 0 percent among 100 BK540 controls. Figure 4D illustrates focal basal vesicles/cysts. The affected subset's length score is 3.5 +/- 0.32 SD on an ordinal 0-4 scale, not an all-canal mean or micrometre measurement. The length-distribution Fisher 3x2 P=1.2e-6 does not separately test each pictured morphology. Supplement S2 instead reports 75 canals, 15 short canals and fraction 0.204; the disagreement remains unresolved.
edges.subject: exc13-rnai

causal_graphs.family_mapping: EXC-13/C03G6.5 maps to UniProtKB:O01454, C. elegans reference taxon 6239, sequence version 4, 203 residues, PF01579 at 33-198 inclusive. UniProt and InterPro sequences agree. Reference mapping establishes family membership, not the RNAi specificity, mutant product or domain sufficiency.
causal_graphs.limitations: No target-specific rescue is established. Table 2 and Supplement Table S2 disagree on sample count and frequency; these are not pooled. The main-table P value is just outside the authors' high-confidence cutoff. VC40373 carries other mutations and has a different phenotype, so it is not treated as isolated C44Y causation. No disulfide, secretion or biochemical mechanism is inferred.

Abnormal excretory canals with focal vesicles and swollen cytoplasm

causal_graphs.scope: C. elegans BK540 exposed to feeding RNAi targeting exc-13/C03G6.5; not isolated DUF19 or an isogenic C44Y mutant.
causal_graphs.title: EXC-13 RNAi increases abnormal excretory-canal morphology

causal_graphs.context: Day 6, 25 C, one independent experiment; L4440 empty vector and rab-5 RNAi are negative and positive controls. Figure 1 source data report counts in zero, 1-10 and greater-than-10 aggregate categories. Exact strain, RNAi insert and exposure start were not established from the accessible caption and source sheet; the distinct day-4/from-egg Extended Data 2 experiment is not substituted.

evidence.explanation: The public caption identifies the assay; the specific C36C5.5 row and its L4440 control in Figure 1 source data Panel k support the direction and counts. Figure 1 was not visually checked.
Distinguishes C36C5.5 from the nearby C36C5.12 accession and from EXC-13.

edges.mechanism: C36C5.5 RNAi gives category counts 20/87/45 among 152 animals, versus 50/90/0 among 140 L4440 controls, ordered as zero/1-10/greater-than-10 aggregates. The source reports an ordinal-logistic coefficient of 2.22946, SE 0.25801 and P<2.2e-16. This is a phenotypic shift with unresolved molecular intermediates; no biochemical aggregation-rate constant is claimed.
edges.subject: c36c5-5-rnai

causal_graphs.family_mapping: C36C5.5, now exh-1, is UniProtKB:O16405, C. elegans N2 reference taxon 6239, sequence version 1, 204 residues, PF01579 at 34-198 inclusive. UniProt and InterPro sequences agree. O16406 is C36C5.12 and is not this tested gene.
causal_graphs.limitations: Main text and Methods were paywalled; exact panel-specific strain and knockdown specificity remain open. One independent experiment is not replicated merely because it contains many animals. The endpoint is reporter aggregation, not a directly measured holdase reaction or family-wide function.

nodes.label: RNAi targeting C36C5.5 in the Figure 1k reporter assay

causal_graphs.scope: C. elegans LBP-2::tagRFP reporter animals in Gallotta et al. Figure 1k, with RNAi against C36C5.5; not EXC-13 or a domain-selective perturbation.
causal_graphs.title: C36C5.5 RNAi shifts the LBP-2 aggregation distribution upward

causal_graphs.context: Day 6, two independent experiments with LBP-2::tagRFP reporter. Supplement Table 5 catalogs pmyo-3-driven C36C5.5 fusions in DCD311 and integrated derivatives, but the inspected figure caption/source table does not uniquely assign the strain. The 25 C stated for Figure 2c is not silently applied to panel b.

evidence.explanation: Public Figure 2b, its caption and both replicates in the source sheet support the comparison. Table 5 supplies construct context without a verified unique panel-to-strain assignment.
Verifies the family mapping of the overexpressed gene's reference protein, not the exact fusion or isolated-domain activity.

edges.mechanism: In replicate 1, zero/1-10/greater-than-10 aggregate counts are 59/24/0 among 83 overexpressing animals versus 25/60/0 among 85 siblings. Replicate 2 gives 40/13/0 among 53 versus 28/47/2 among 77 siblings. Reported Fisher P values are 1e-7 and 1.5e-5. Molecular intermediates remain unresolved; this is not a purified-domain holdase assay.
edges.subject: c36c5-5-overexpression

causal_graphs.family_mapping: The gene C36C5.5/exh-1 maps to O16405, sequence version 1, 204 residues, PF01579 at 34-198 inclusive. The tested protein is tagged and overexpressed, not an isolated 34-198 domain; exact tag junction and clone sequence remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Caption, source data, Figure 2 image and Supplement Table 5 are accessible; main text and Methods were not inspected. Co-purification in panel d supports association but does not resolve the path by which overexpression reduces aggregation. Other extracellular regulators are not treated as DUF19 proteins without separate mapping.

nodes.label: LBP-2::tagRFP aggregation at day 6 relative to siblings

causal_graphs.scope: C. elegans transgenic C36C5.5::mVenus::histag overexpression compared with non-overexpressing siblings in Figure 2b.
causal_graphs.title: C36C5.5 overexpression reduces LBP-2 reporter aggregation

causal_graphs.context: Day 6, two independent experiments with LBP-2::tagRFP reporter and coelomocytes absent. Table 5 catalogs DCD387 with unc-119(ed3), cdIs32 coelomocyte ablation, uqIs27 C36C5.5 fusion and uqIs5 reporter; a unique panel-to-strain assignment and exact assay temperature remain unverified from the accessible material.

evidence.explanation: Figure 2e's public caption, visually inspected figure and both source-data replicates support the separate coelomocyte-absent comparison with its secreted-GFP control. The word prevents in the caption is not interpreted as zero aggregates in all animals.
evidence.snippet: ECR C36C5.5 efficiently prevents LBP-2 aggregation

edges.mechanism: With coelomocytes absent, replicate 1 has zero/1-10/greater-than-10 aggregate counts 52/22/1 among 75 C36C5.5-overexpressing animals versus 8/48/26 among 82 secreted-GFP controls. Replicate 2 has 46/70/0 among 116 versus 0/95/26 among 121 controls. The source reports chi-square P<1e-8 for both comparisons. The fixed ablation background is part of the tested context, not a second independent sufficient cause.
edges.subject: c36c5-5-oe-without-coelomocytes

causal_graphs.family_mapping: C36C5.5/exh-1 is O16405, PF01579 at 34-198 in the 204-residue reference. Neither the coelomocyte ablation transgene nor secreted GFP is the DUF19 member; this comparison tests C36C5.5 overexpression in a fixed ablation context.
causal_graphs.limitations: This is not an experiment demonstrating that endogenous C36C5.5 acts only independently of coelomocytes. It does not establish direct binding as the causal intermediate or transfer the effect to EXC-13. Main Methods, clone junctions and raw images remain unreviewed.

nodes.label: LBP-2 reporter aggregation relative to secreted-GFP control

causal_graphs.scope: Separate coelomocyte-absent arms in Gallotta et al. Figure 2e; C36C5.5 overexpression compared with secreted-GFP overexpression, not the sibling control from panel b.
causal_graphs.title: C36C5.5 overexpression reduces reporter aggregation without coelomocytes
